_comment: Jarvis MCP connector registry. Pure data — add a connector by adding an entry; no code changes. The layer is enabled by default (settings.enabled=true; env JARVIS_ENABLE_MCP=1 also force-enables it). Each connector is toggled with its own 'enabled': turn one on only once it is fully configured (real 'url', 'tool' name(s), and auth). Secrets are NEVER stored here: 'auth_env' names the environment variable that holds the token. A connector only fires when the query matches its 'match_any' substrings or 'match_regex'. Any fetch failure is caught and skipped, so a down/absent server never breaks a query.

connectors.name: truthify
connectors._note: Financial institutions: Prudential, Fidelity, Raymond James. Disabled until Truthify's MCP endpoint, tool name(s), and auth are confirmed. Set the real 'url', the 'tool' name(s), export the token named by 'auth_env', then flip 'enabled' to true. If Truthify does not expose MCP, leave this disabled — taxmcp.io keeps working independently.

connectors.name: taxmcp
connectors._note: IRS / U.S. federal tax authority via taxmcp.io. Remote streamable-HTTP MCP at https://app.taxmcp.io/mcp. Auth is OAuth 2.0 only (no static API key): the first tax query opens your browser once to sign in and approve scope 'mcp:use'; the access/refresh tokens are then cached in jarvis_storage/.mcp_tokens.json (chmod 600, git-ignored) and refreshed automatically on later runs. If sign-in is declined or unavailable, the connector is skipped and the turn still answers from local evidence. Plan tiers gate results (Free=IRC only, 20/day; Pro=all federal; Pro+=case law+state). Primary tool is 'search-tax-law'.
